subtopic: Variable Life Insurance Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: These fees and expenses may be significant and will reduce the value of your account. They may require you to pay additional premiums to prevent the policy from lapsing (terminating).
question: How can fees and expenses affect a variable life insurance policy?
answer: Fees and expenses reduce the policy’s account value. If the value is not sufficient to cover them, you may need to pay additional premiums to prevent the policy from lapsing.
